key.name: panel-height
key.summary: Height of the taskbar in pixels

key.name: icon-size
key.summary: Size of application icons

key.name: clock-position
key.summary: Where the clock is placed

key.name: show-activities
key.summary: Show the Activities button

key.name: show-user-button
key.summary: Show the user button
key.description: A round button with the user's picture at the very left, with a menu to edit the profile, suspend, restart, power off or log out.

key.name: show-apps-button
key.summary: Show the app grid button

key.name: show-favorites
key.summary: Show pinned (favorite) applications

key.name: window-previews
key.summary: Show window previews when hovering a running app

key.name: multi-monitor
key.summary: Show a taskbar on every monitor

key.name: isolate-monitors
key.summary: Only show windows on the taskbar's own monitor

key.name: dot-color
key.summary: Colour of the open-window dots, as #rrggbb
key.description: Full strength for the focused app, 50% for the others.

key.name: isolate-workspaces
key.summary: Only show windows from the current workspace

key.name: border
key.summary: Draw a 1px border
key.description: Around the classic bar, or around each zone. Hidden while a window is maximized.

key.name: border-color
key.summary: Border colour, as #rrggbb

key.name: border-opacity
key.summary: Border opacity in percent

key.name: dynamic-opacity
key.summary: Make the background translucent unless a window is maximized

key.name: background-opacity
key.summary: Background opacity in percent when no window is maximized

key.name: zones
key.summary: Split the taskbar into three rounded zones
key.description: Activities, apps and clock each get their own rounded, slightly raised background. While a window is maximized the taskbar goes back to one solid bar.

key.name: zone-radius
key.summary: Corner roundness of the zones in pixels

key.name: zone-float
key.summary: How far the zones float above the bottom edge in pixels

key.name: zone-gap
key.summary: Gap between the outer zones and the screen edges in pixels

key.name: zone-padding
key.summary: Space inside each zone, left and right, in pixels

key.name: background-color
key.summary: Background colour of the taskbar, as #rrggbb

key.name: overview-transparent
key.summary: Make the background fully transparent in the overview

key.name: hide-overview-dash
key.summary: Hide the GNOME dash in the overview
